character.name: Idle
character.prompt:
Create a production-ready side-view pixel-art NPC for a 1990s-style 2D point-and-click adventure game set in an Italian middle school.

Male school cleaner, approximately 50–55 years old, slightly eccentric and instantly recognizable, but still grounded and believable.

Appearance:

medium-short height
sturdy, slightly stocky build
slightly messy dark hair with some grey
large expressive moustache
friendly and harmless face
mildly absent-minded expression

His most recognizable feature is a pair of very large padded 1990s stereo headphones, visually prominent but still believable.

A small portable cassette player is clipped to his belt, with a visible headphone cable running from the player to the headphones.

Clothing:

practical school-cleaning work trousers
simple work shirt with rolled-up sleeves
sleeveless utility vest
worn comfortable sneakers
subtly mismatched socks as a small humorous visual detail

He holds a traditional long-handled floor mop.

He is completely absorbed in the music:

relaxed posture
tiny content smile
shoulders subtly following the rhythm
one foot occasionally tapping to the beat

He is not intentionally blocking anyone. He is simply cleaning the floor while being unaware that Elena wants to pass.

The character should feel slightly funny and memorable without becoming slapstick.

Strict side view, facing RIGHT.

Full body visible, including shoes and the entire mop.

Strong readable silhouette at small scale.

Crisp deliberate pixel art, grounded anatomy, expressive face, 1990s European narrative-adventure aesthetic.

Transparent background.

Do not make him look dirty, threatening, incompetent or grotesque.

Animation requirement: create the design so his main idle animation can consist of:

slowly moving the mop left and right across the floor
shifting his shoulders slightly to the music
tapping one foot to the beat
occasionally tilting his head as if enjoying the song

No walking animation is required for the initial scene.
